_readme: Every key is optional. A key left out is taken from the Shopify theme. Rename to config.json and pass it with --config.
_agency: Your agency or company name. When set, it appears discreetly in the slide footer. Leave null for an unbranded report.
_lang: Report language. Ships with en and fr; see the i18n folder.

brand._bg: Slide background. Leave null to take the theme's.
brand._accent: Primary brand colour, used as fill and on the cover.
brand._accent2: Supporting colour, used as the second chart series.
brand._font_heading: Heading font. Only name a brand font if the person opening the deck has it installed, otherwise PowerPoint substitutes it and the layout shifts.
